newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers 300 MW power Thurs through Sat.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers 300 MW power Thurs through Sat.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) is offering up to 300 megawatts (MW) of peak load power for Friday and Saturday at $31.50 per megawatt hour (MWh), the federal agency said Tuesday.
Up to 300 MW of peak power was being offered for Thursday at $29.50 per MWh, BPA said.
Also for Thursday, BPA said it was offering up to 300 MW of light-load power at $21.25, with offers in the Northwest and the California Oregon Border (COB) at $22.00 per MWh.
Thursday peak power for the Northwest and COB was offered at $30.00 and $30.75 respectively.
Up to 300 megawatts of light-load power for Friday and Saturday was offered at $22.25, with offers at $23.00 for the Northwest and COB.
Heavy load power with a limit of 300 MW for Friday and Saturday was offered at $32.00 in the Northwest and $32.75 at COB, BPA said.
On Monday, BPA offered peak power for Tuesday and Wednesday delivery at $31.50, with offers in the Northwest at $32.00 and $32.75 at COB.
